findings.text: follow-on: the eight-line comment explaining why an empty list clears the digest is duplicated almost verbatim at :639 in _stop, so the shared rationale has two copies that can drift.

follow-on: test_a_fresh_snapshot_is_formatted_as_todays_output compares the injected text against format_checklist of a payload the test itself derived moments before, so it would pass whether the hook read the snapshot or re-derived the same list; the snapshot-not-derive property rests on :234 and :364, not on this case.

follow-on: this file is not in the node's fence and its change (a _publish_snapshot call per prompt drive) is a real behavioural edit to eleven existing cases, recorded only as a scope extension in the manifest rather than a declared write path.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (d31eaab81, 740e5c63, bf6ffd2dc) against e23f6cc6; 814 insertions across the two source files, the legacy hook test, the new test file and the evidence fragment, and no file outside that set.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names an explicit measure; the manifest records both gate arms (base 2 failed / 92 passed at e23f6cc6, head 2 failed / 97 passed at bf6ffd2dc, the same two pre-existing tests/test_skill_contracts.py ids), the new five-case file at 5 passed, the negative control's 4-failed/1-passed red log, and 20 hook timings whose second-slowest is 112.7 ms against the 250 ms target.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the prompt hook reads the session's published snapshot instead of deriving obligations; reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:572 _prompt reads the snapshot, classifies its freshness and formats it, and reaches no derivation module.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, baseline_suite and after_suite both carry completed true with the matching two-id failure sets, and the landing line states the gate figure and the 112.7 ms timing.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's declared paths cover reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py and tests/test_obligations_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py; the one extra file in the diff, tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py, is recorded in evidence_inputs as a received scope extension and is absent from the fence list in the manifest's orientation_write_paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_obligations_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py:234 reddens when the derivation is reintroduced (negative-control-bf6ffd2dc-mutated.log:4 failed/1 passed) and :364 forbids the live blocked run appearing, so a snapshot read is distinguished from a derive.
justifications.evidence: the gate the done-when names ran at both arms (base-gate-e23f6cc6-final.log:2 failed/92 passed, head-gate-bf6ffd2dc.log:2 failed/97 passed) and the negative control log records 4 failed/1 passed with EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's idiom and introduce no plan label, but the empty-list digest rationale is duplicated verbatim at reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:612 and :639.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:572 _prompt reads the snapshot through the file-path-loaded module, applies the lane rewrite and the digest unchanged, and never writes the snapshot, which is exactly the goal.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is a declared write path except tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py, which the manifest records as a received extension, and the stop path was correctly left as on main.
